Rätselhaft!

A repo. A scientific publication. Many new research questions.

Lea Berger opens up historical puzzle books with a small team. The chair has been researching the topic for years. In the three-year project, systematic corpus analyses are added: students examine rhyme forms; external researchers compare local language models.

The open TEI corpus is itself a scientific publication on GitHub. Others are supposed to be able to download, understand and evaluate a designated version. Lea is planning the publication from the beginning. After the end of the project it should remain usable even without its personal introduction.

How does our working population turn into a scientific data publication with which others can conduct independent research?
